claim.statement: Pickle is an OCI registry on every node (port 5050) that caches upstream registries, shares layers peer to peer, and receives images built on the cluster with relish build; images are replicated asynchronously to a default of 2 copies.

sources.quote: Every node runs Pickle, the built-in registry
redundancy target (default 2 total copies: the pusher plus one peer)
an image pushed and then immediately lost with its origin node before the heal tick runs is not guaranteed to survive

claim.measurable: After pushing/building an image, curl the registry on port 5050 of each node (/v2/); a pull on a second node is served from a peer; the heal loop (roughly every 60 s) brings copies to 2 within the 30 s per layer target (the whitepaper marks that target unmeasured); killing the only origin node before the heal tick can lose the image.
